text_usage: %s of %s characters used in this billing period.
msg_limit_reached: The quota is used up - translations are possible again in the next billing period.
placeholder_new_key: Enter a new key to replace it
hint_auth_key: You'll find the key in your DeepL account under "API Keys". It is checked with DeepL before it is saved.
text_set_auth_key: You need to save a DeepL API key to use the translations.
text_keep_auth_key_private: The key is stored in the plugin's database and is never shown in full.
msg_key_invalid: DeepL rejected the key - it was not saved.
hint_target_langs: The hooks translate into these languages. The mapping shows the DeepL language code that is used.
msg_no_target_langs: Please select at least one target language.
hint_formality: Not every language supports formality - it is ignored there.
hint_ignore_tags: Comma-separated list. Content inside these tags stays unchanged. Elements with translate="no" are always ignored.
hint_protect_shortcodes: Shortcodes like [snippet]…[/snippet] or [plugin=…]…[/plugin] are not translated.
hook_page_all: DeepL: Translate page into all linked languages
hook_page_all_desc: Translates title, link name, content and meta data and overwrites the linked translation pages.
hook_product_all: DeepL: Translate the whole product into all linked languages
hook_product_all_desc: Title, teaser, all descriptions, labels, tags and meta data.
hook_product_teaser_desc: Translates title and teaser into all linked languages.
hook_product_descriptions_desc: Translates text, additional texts 1-5 incl. labels and scope of delivery.
hook_product_metas_desc: Translates meta title, meta description and tags.
msg_no_api_key: No DeepL API key saved (Addons > DeepL > Settings).
msg_no_targets: DeepL: No linked translations found - enter the translation URLs.
msg_editor_reset: The target page used a block editor and was switched to HTML.
hint_exclude_langs: Ticked languages are skipped when saving with a DeepL hook - the translation URL stays in place.
msg_target_ambiguous: Several products found at "%s" (%s) - nothing translated.
msg_target_needs_catalog: "%s" contains no catalog page - enter catalog page + slug, e.g. shop/product/.
